name: Gobisaurus
sum: Gobisaurus is a basal ankylosaurid from the Early Cretaceous of Inner Mongolia, known from a large skull.
holotype: IVPP V12563, a skull 46 cm long — Miaogou Formation, Maortu locality, Inner Mongolia.
material: A skull; the postcranial skeleton found with it was lost.
biology: A herbivorous basal ankylosaurid; the sources used give no behavioural data.
author: Vickaryous et al. 2001
